speaker: Liora
text: Shh — watch. If I feed the flame JUST enough, it dances on the water and never touches it.

options.text: You're going to set the lake on fire one day.
Isn't this against about six academy rules?
Liora... it's you I keep coming back here for.

speaker: Liora
text: ...Breathing. YES. That's exactly — nobody ever says it right. It's not a weapon out here, it's a creature. You actually see it.

speaker: Liora
text: Come by again. I'll teach it your name.

speaker: Liora
text: One time. ONE time, and the fish were fine.

speaker: Liora
text: Seven, actually. You sound like Maren. The flame doesn't read the handbook and neither do I — off you go, rule-keeper.

speaker: Liora
text: The flame just flared and I did NOT do that. ...Say it again. Slower. I want to remember how the lake looked when you did.

speaker: Kai
text: It's you, Liora. It's been you for a while.

speaker: Liora
text: Then keep coming back. Every evening. That's the price, and I don't haggle.
